# Adversarial review — the one-verdict gate
Semantic pattern: **paired policy-evaluation traces** -> visual type: **flowchart** * parked HUMAN_GATE with an INVALIDATED dependency * verified at HEAD `19e47d9` + F14 tamper + F15-audit/Q-05 follow-up
SHARED RULES (both traces) R1 operator credential verify — constant-time (F2) R2 gate exists and is WAITING_HUMAN R3 dep INVALIDATED after parking -> diagnostic    note only — never a veto R4 one-verdict journal check — transactional (F6),    schema index (F9) R5 verdict applies in ONE fenced transaction    (RUNNING -> event -> terminal -> HumanGateResolved) first divergence: only the terminal event differs (GatePassed vs GateFailed) same rules, same parked situation, two legal verdicts -> both resolve Trace A — verdict APPROVED gate parked; dep INVALIDATED after parking R1 PASS * R2 PASS * R3 note (never veto) R4 PASS — journal has no prior verdict R5 one transaction: RUNNING -> GatePassed -> SUCCEEDED -> HumanGateResolved OUTCOME: SUCCEEDED mode returns ACTIVE; escape hatch used Trace B — verdict REJECTED same parked gate, same INVALIDATED dep R1 PASS * R2 PASS * R3 note (never veto) R4 PASS — journal has no prior verdict R5 one transaction: RUNNING -> GateFailed -> FAILED -> HumanGateResolved OUTCOME: FAILED (as ordered) mode returns ACTIVE; no permanent park REFUSED PATHS wrong operator token ✗ OPERATOR refusal; gate stays WAITING_HUMAN; nothing lands status tampered back to WAITING_HUMAN ✗ journal consulted — ALREADY_RESOLVED (F14); no second verdict crash mid-verdict ✗ R5 is one transaction — ROLLBACK; zero half-state (crash-injection test) forged duplicate GatePassed ✗ one verdict only — second resolve NOT_WAITING (F14) forged HumanGateResolved ✗ ALREADY_RESOLVED — tamper can only deny, never grant concurrent second controller ✗ LOCK refusal (lease held) — nothing lands Trace status is text + outline (never color alone) * green outline = PASS, red = FAIL/forbidden * escape hatch: the operator verdict resolves a gate whose dep was INVALIDATED after parking

| Tests | `test_11_resolve_verdict_lands_in_one_transaction` (crash injection), `test_11_escape_hatch_invalidated_dep_after_parking_still_resolvable`, `test_11_parked_gate_invalidated_dep_diagnostic_note`, `test_11_journal_one_verdict_under_status_tamper` (F14), `test_11_forged_gate_events_can_refuse_but_never_authorize` (F14), `test_11_forged_journal_events_cannot_bypass_one_verdict_under_race` (F14), `test_f6_one_verdict_race_closed`, F2 constant-time test * F15-audit/Q-05 (composition): `test_21_q05_operator_gate_resolution_never_touches_epistemic_state` (the verdict leaves the entire epistemic surface byte-identical — zero classification/ladder/proposal events), `test_21_f15_rejected_gate_wave_stops_recovery_still_completes` (REJECTED is terminal: one GateFailed + one HumanGateResolved, second resolve NOT_WAITING, recovery still completes once), `test_21_f15_rejected_gate_wave_redispatch_downstream` (an independent task re-dispatches past the FAILED gate and completes exactly once), `test_21_f15_operator_resolve_racing_recovery_first_miss` (the verdict races B's mid-recovery tick loop: exactly one verdict, no FAILED hop before the HumanGateResolved event, completion once at attempt 2), `test_21_f15_second_gate_reparks_wave` (gate-1 REJECTED returns ACTIVE, gate-2 re-parks AWAITING_HUMAN in the same tick; each gate exactly one verdict, zero cross-talk), `test_21_f15_rejected_verdict_race_retryable_task` (REJECTED races the mid-recovery tick loop on a retryable worker: one GateFailed + one HumanGateResolved, retry re-executes once at attempt 2), `test_21_f15_resolve_race_outcome_invariant_across_schedules` (property-style: six seeded random schedules all yield exactly one verdict and one completion), `test_21_f15_rejected_verdict_race_retries_exhausted` (REJECTED races the mid-recovery tick loop on an exhausted worker: worker FAILED at attempt 1, never re-executed, wave stops), `test_21_f15_second_gate_property_schedules` (property-style re-park: five seeded schedules, each gate exactly one verdict, one completion at attempt 2) |
